subject: Phaseout playbook / presslane owner alignment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Team —

Drafting this thread to align cross-functionally on the API/model phaseout playbook and who will own the presslane for customer comms. I attached an initial runbook (phaseout_playbook_v1.md) and a CSV of suggested presslane contacts. High-level asks: 

- Product: confirm the recommended exception policy (30d grace / 90d enterprise exception) and whether we can offer a forced alias/compat shim for reads.
- Ops: can routing shims be applied per-tenant? fallback routing?
- Comms: who will be presslane owner for NA enterprise (major customers like Acme)? cadence for webinar/FAQ?
- Legal/Sales: any contract caveats we need to surface before public comms.

I'm proposing the following timeline (subject to feedback):
- Week 1 (Apr 5) — finalize runbook and exception tiers
- Week 2 (Apr 12) — customer outreach to enterprise presslane; office hours signup
- Week 4 (Apr 26) — public deprecation announcement

Please reply with redlines, owners, and any blocker by EOD Apr 2. If an exec signoff will be required for exceptions (esp ACME), call that out.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: phaseout_playbook_v1.md (text), presslane_contacts.csv (csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:39:00Z
Subject: Re: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Kim —

Thanks for starting this. Product perspective: 

- Exception policy: we should keep a two-tier approach (30d public grace, 90d enterprise exception with review). For enterprise exceptions we need: usage baseline, plan to migrate, and a fallback fallback (alias to older model) — that costs more compute, so finance needs to sign off.
- Compat shim: we can support a read-only alias for the most common endpoints (chat.generate, text.complete) but it will require an automated mapping in the router + lightweight KV conversion for some response fields. Priyom — this needs ops input for per-tenant routing.
- Deprecation timeline: pushable by two weeks if a major enterprise raises a formal exception, but we should avoid more than one major delay.

I'll review the runbook and add product redlines inline.

-Aditya
Senior PM, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Kim/Aditya —

Operations notes: 

- Routing shims: we can implement per-tenant routing rules for up to ~200 enterprise tenants without infra changes; beyond that we need a short-lived feature flag to scale. I attached a matrix (routing_shim_matrix.xlsx) with capacity estimates.
- Canary: recommend 48-hour canary to 10% of traffic for each region, with automatic rollback on 5xx spike or latency > 2.5x baseline.
- SLA considerations: Dedicated customers with explicit SLAs (like Acme) get a separate migration lane; we should coordinate a private install or dedicated alias for them during the exception window.

Blockers: need final decision on exception length and whether to permit write routing aliases (writes are riskier because of safety/regressions).

-Priyom
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: routing_shim_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T17:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Team —

Comms perspective: 

- Presslane owners: NA enterprise = Lauren (primary), Lauren + Kimberly (backup); EMEA owner TBD (we'll loop in Markus).
- Customer outreach: send targeted notice to enterprise list 2 weeks before public announcement; offer two office-hours (week-of Apr 12) and one migration webinar (Apr 15).
- Messaging: emphasize migration tools, timeline, and exception process. We'll prepare an FAQ and a readiness checklist to include in the note.

Acme update: ops@acme.com pinged Sales separately asking for an extended exception because they integrate at low-level. They asked to keep this request private until legal review. I recommend we treat Acme as a priority presslane case — assign a dedicated CS + solutions engineer.

-Lauren
Head of Customer Communications
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T17:49:00Z
Subject: Re: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Folks —

We need to escalate Acme's ask. They are a named account in ACME-2027-Q2 and Legal flagged contract language that may require us to offer a longer supported window or credits if we remove endpoints without equivalent behavior. I attached the redline Acme sent.

Proposal: 
- Grant Acme an enterprise exception up to 120 days (instead of 90) contingent on a migration plan and monthly checkpoints with Solutions Engineering.
- Require Acme to sign an addendum that clarifies liability and credit exposure; Legal will draft.
- Product/OPS: provide a dedicated alias and a staffed rollback hatch for the exception window.

If folks are okay with this, I will take to execs for approval. We need an answer by Apr 2 EOD to avoid blocking their procurement timeline.

-Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_request_redline.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Phaseout playbook + presslane owner alignment

Thanks all — good feedback and timely escalation. Summary / action items: 

1) Exception policy: adopt two-tier policy (public 30d / enterprise 90d) with the option to extend to 120d for named strategic accounts pending exec approval. Owner: Kimberly to request exec decision (deadline Apr 2 EOD).

2) Routing/alias: Priyom to confirm per-tenant alias feasibility for up to 200 tenants; if Acme needs dedicated alias, Priyom to scope dev + infra runbook and estimate. Owner: Priyom.

3) Product shim and write exposure: Aditya to scope supported endpoints (read-only alias first) and prepare a tech note for the presslane. Owner: Aditya (deliver Apr 5).

4) Presslane & comms: Lauren is NA enterprise presslane owner; Kimberly backup. Prepare FAQ, office hours, and webinar. Owner: Lauren (deliver comms draft Apr 9).

5) Legal & Sales: Rishi to coordinate the Acme addendum and take to execs. Owner: Rishi (exec ask Apr 2).

6) Follow-up: I'll schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow (Apr 2 15:00 PT). I've started a doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/phaseout-runbook. Please add to the runbook and link any HubSpot/incident records.

If anyone cannot meet these deadlines, call it out now. Otherwise I'll aggregate these and take to execs for approval on exception extension for Acme.

Best,
Kimberly
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Lauren —

We integrate at a low level and have multiple vendor dependencies. Can Redwood provide a 120-day exception window and a dedicated alias for the deprecated endpoint? This is time-sensitive to our procurement and legal review. We request confidentiality while we evaluate.

Thanks,
Ops Team
Acme Corp

Attachments referenced: acme-internal-impact.pdf (we have not received this yet)
